content.comment_body: Hello, I'm facing a challenge where I need to adjust the ON and OFF threshold of [article_no] by 5% (OFF by 10%) and apply it to [article_no]. In simulation mode, this works as intended, however with the actual [product_name] hardware it does not. [article_no] displays the correct value during online testing, but it fails to transfer that value into the parameters list of [article_no]. I exported the ON value to [article_no] and OFF to [article_no], modifying them via the web server page, but it still doesn't function as expected. Thank you for your assistance. [user_name]

Hello, it looks like you have developed a program. Would you mind uploading it? Just providing a description and referencing block numbers doesn't give enough context for others to understand what you’ve implemented. How can anyone help without that?

Hi [user_name], are you able to view the attached image? I can’t see it on my phone. The issue seems to be that the arithmetic instruction is meant to pull P1 from an analog amplifier, but it’s not doing so. In the online test the analog output is correctly calculated, but Aq in the parameter list remains at zero. What could I be doing incorrectly? The simulation works perfectly, but the actual hardware does not match this behavior. Is it possible there is a firmware issue? Firmware version [version_no]. I'll attach a diagram now, but again, everything looks good in simulation. Thanks.

Everything is functioning normally. The parameter table values under blocks are only refreshed during simulation mode. You can check the actual analog block output values by placing the cursor over a block, and then clicking the small glasses icon on the right beneath the block. This will display the current values.

You could try updating your firmware to the latest version [version_no]. Start by updating to [version_no], then proceed to [version_no]. There’s product information available on the firmware update for [product_name] regarding security vulnerability CVE-2020-7593.

Your firmware ([version_no]) is the initial release for [product_name] [version_no]. Subsequent updates included [version_no], along with the update from [product_name] to [product_name] [version_no] ([product_name] [version_no]). You can find information about [product_name] [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Users report issues with syncing simulation results and real device behavior when adjusting analog block thresholds in [product_name] hardware. Although parameter modifications work in simulation and appear functional via the web server, these changes don't reliably update on the physical device's parameter list or analog outputs, causing confusion regarding what is updated in simulation versus real-time operation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that any parameter changes performed in simulation mode, online tests, or through the web server will be instantly reflected on the actual device, updating outputs and parameter listings during real-time operation.
